svg.title: Diagram 03, trust boundaries between the zones and the planes
svg.desc: Two SPIFFE trust domains, zone-a and zone-b, each one cluster. Inside each zone the data-plane workloads, which hold SVIDs, sit next to the management-plane components placed in that zone: the SPIRE server, the OpenTelemetry Collector and cmcd. Calls from the data plane into that management plane are denied by default at both the NetworkPolicy and the mesh layer and are allowed only along the ZT-55 allow-matrix paths: named mTLS pairs and the ZT-26 observability export. Zone-a reaches zone-b only through the attested channel plus a TRAIN verdict. The management-plane components whose placement is not yet recorded, TRAIN (TCR and TSPA), the TSA policy engine and OCM, are drawn outside both zones; both zones reach them under the same rule, the ZT-55 allow matrix at both layers. Anything without an SVID or with an unsigned image is denied: it cannot join or cannot start. The allow matrix in architecture section 6 is the place of record for every permitted path.
